title: CES evidence catalog (one released batch)
description: One row per evidence definition: one NIST SP 800-171A examine-list object for one requirement, pointing at one reusable form. This is the data shape BHD proposes for the 'catalog, not kit' approach (BHD response of 2026-10-26, section 5, workstream WS-1). Releases are governed (editor, approver, change log); the file is read by Muster and EvidenceOps and never edited through open CRUD.

catalog_version.description: Semantic version of the released batch set, e.g. 0.1.0

practice_id_convention.description: Which practice-id spelling the file uses for the 17 Level 1 practices: 'L2-guide-v2.13' = AC.L2-3.1.1 (CMMC Assessment Guide Level 2 v2.13); 'ces-shared-2021' = AC.L1-3.1.1 (CES shared reference). BHD decides this under requirement R-4; readers must normalise the level away as CES code already does.

definition_id.description: <practice id>#E<nn>, nn = 1-based position of the object in the 800-171A examine list (see nist-800-171a-examine-lists.json), so the id is reproducible from NIST.

form_id.description: Muster template_id (snake_case) for rendered forms and registers; the same id is reused across every requirement whose examine list names the same document type

legacy_alias.description: The id used in the 26 Oct package (e.g. ACP-001), kept for traceability only

emx_ids.description: Evidence archetype ids (uppercase, from the Evidence Archetype Catalog). Empty means 'no archetype fits; propose one'.

emx_proposed_new.description: Free-text proposals for archetypes the catalog lacks

objective_ids.description: Assessment objective ids this document evidences, e.g. AC.L1-3.1.1[a] (ces-shared assessment-objectives.reference.json)

production.description: signal = an existing automated tenant read evidences it; capture = exported from the tenant and rendered as a register; rendered = Muster renders the document from collected inputs; attested = a short human-completed form for facts outside the tenant

status_effect.description: Attested and captured documents never change a control's status or enter the verified-artifact list (BHD decision DEC-7). Fixed value.

collection_guidance.description: What the assessor or customer should check (the 26 Oct package's 'CES recommendation' text belongs here)

gcc_high_checked.description: For capture/signal rows: the Graph endpoint and permission were confirmed available in GCC High
